vv74:2.1: Dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vaggū aṭṭhaṭṭhakā sikkhitā sādhurūpā dibbā ca kaññā Tidasacarā uḷārā naccanti gāyanti pamodayanti. [=74].3 Deviddhipatto 'si mahānubhāvo
vv74:2.4: vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti. [=74].4
vv74:5.2: tena me idha-m-ijjhati uppajjanti ca me bhogā ye keci manaso piyā. [=74].6 Akkhāmi te bhikkhu mahānubhāva manussabhūto yam akāsi puññaṃ ten' amhi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo
vv74:5.3: vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti. Uttaravimānaṃ
